item.tib: zhabs rten nor bu 'bar ba'i tog gi tshig 'grel nyung thus bstan pa'i dar chen
item.coloph: zhes pa 'di yang rang gi rtsa ba'i bla ma lha mchog stag la me 'bar dang / rig 'dzin li shu stag ring gi ngo bo gcig tu bsdus te snyigs dus sangs rgyas gnyis par byon pa grub dbang bstan 'dzin rin chen rgyal mtshan mchog gis lha rdzas srid na ring ba dang / rin chen dang po zho gang bcas brtsal te zhabs rten 'di yi 'grel chung bgyis dgos zhabs brtan 'di nyid gzhan las khyad par 'phags pa tshig nyung don tshang 'dug ces bka' brjid gser gyi lhun po spyi bor ldog med du phab par/ gyen ldog ma nus pa nyi ri shel zhin bdag gis thol shar brtsams te phul ba dge bar gyur cig/
